build_leaderboard_get_elo_ratings: build a fastapi endpoint to get model leaderboard with Elo ratings filtered by optional query
create_feedback_entry: create a new user feedback entry with model comparison data and tags
get_feedbacks_paginated_list: get a paginated list of feedback items with configurable order and direction
update_feedback_by_id: update an existing feedback entry by its id with new form data
delete_feedback_by_id: delete a feedback entry by its id as admin or owner user
